title: RoleWorld: Knowledge Transfer in World Modeling with Functional Role Abstractions
title_zh: RoleWorld：基于功能角色抽象的世界建模中的知识迁移

paragraphs.en: World models enable large language model (LLM) agents to anticipate action effects and make informed decisions. For generalization, it is desirable for such world models to transfer efficiently to new environments with similar interaction structure and underlying dynamics. Recent approaches encode world dynamics as symbolic rules or executable programs, whose compositional structure in principle affords transfer, but still organize such knowledge around environment-specific objects. To address this limitation, we introduce RoleWorld , a symbolic world modeling approach which uses reusable prototypes and environment-specific parameter values as functional role abstractions to represent how objects behave in interactions. From interaction trajectories, a teacher LLM extracts role prototypes and executable transition rules defined over role instances, together with a skill that guides the actor LLM to use role information in decision making. In a target world, without the teacher, the actor uses this skill together with its current role assignments and parameter estimates, and actively tests a role instance hypothesis through interaction when its uncertainty affects the current decision. Feedback from each action refines role assignments and estimates parameter values online, with no LLM parameter updates and the transition rules held fixed. Experiments on MARS benchmark show that RoleWorld enables robust generalization across environments with significantly altered object behavior, suggesting that functional role abstractions can serve as an effective component for knowledge transfer in world modeling. Project Page: https://future-item.github.io/RoleWorld.
paragraphs.zh: 世界模型使大型语言模型（LLM）智能体能够预测行动效果并做出明智决策。 为了实现泛化，这类世界模型最好能高效地迁移到具有相似交互结构和底层动态的新环境中。 近期的方法将世界动态编码为符号规则或可执行程序，其组合结构原则上支持迁移，但仍围绕特定环境中的对象组织此类知识。 为解决这一局限性，我们提出了 RoleWorld——一种符号化世界建模方法，它使用可重用的原型和特定环境的参数值作为功能角色抽象，来表示对象在交互中的行为方式。 从交互轨迹中，一个教师 LLM 会提取定义于角色实例上的角色原型和可执行转换规则，以及一个指导演员 LLM 在决策中利用角色信息的技能。 在目标世界中，无需教师模型，演员模型会结合当前的角色分配和参数估计使用这一技能，并在不确定性影响当前决策时，通过交互主动测试角色实例假设。 每次行动的反馈都会在线优化角色分配并更新参数值，而 LLM 的参数无需更新，转换规则也保持固定不变。 在 MARS 基准上的实验表明，RoleWorld 能够在对象行为发生显著变化的不同环境中实现稳健的泛化，这说明功能角色抽象可以成为世界模型中知识迁移的有效组件。 项目页面：https://future-item.github.io/RoleWorld.

paragraphs.en: Learning how the world works enables an agent to anticipate the consequences of its actions and make informed decisions ( Schrittwieser et al., 2020 ) . World models capture such knowledge by describing how actions change the environment ( Ha and Schmidhuber, 2018 ; Hafner et al., 2025 ) , allowing agents, such as Large Language Models (LLMs), to reason about possible outcomes before acting ( Zhou et al., 2025 ) . Recent evaluations increasingly consider agents across multiple related environments or environment variants, rather than within a single fixed world ( Tang et al., 2024b ; Tang et al., 2024a ) . This setting creates a natural need for world models that can reuse previously acquired knowledge when entering a new environment, instead of learning its dynamics entirely from scratch ( Taylor and Stone, 2009 ) . Such transfer is plausible because related environments often preserve substantial interaction structure and underlying dynamics even as their particular configurations vary ( Tang et al., 2024a ) . A central question is therefore how to represent world knowledge so that it can transfer efficiently across related environments.
paragraphs.zh: 学习世界如何运作使智能体能够预测其行为的后果，并做出明智的决策（Schrittwieser 等，2020）。 世界模型通过描述行为如何改变环境来捕捉这类知识（Ha 和 Schmidhuber，2018；Hafner 等，2025），从而让智能体（例如大型语言模型（LLM））在采取行动前能够推理可能的结果（Zhou 等，2025）。 近期的评估越来越多地考察智能体在多个相关环境或环境变体中的表现，而非局限于单一固定的世界（Tang 等，2024b；Tang 等，2024a）。 这种设定自然催生了对世界模型的需求：当进入新环境时，这些模型应能复用先前获得的知识，而不是从头开始重新学习环境的动态规律（Taylor 和 Stone，2009）。 这种知识迁移是合理的，因为相关环境即使具体配置不同，通常仍会保留大量交互结构和底层动态规律（Tang 等，2024a）。 因此，一个核心问题是如何表示世界知识，使其能够高效地在相关环境之间迁移。

paragraphs.en: Recent approaches use LLMs to express world dynamics as symbolic rules or executable programs ( Zhou et al., 2025 ; Tang et al., 2024a ; Piriyakulkij et al., 2025 ) , whose compositional structure provides a natural basis for reuse ( Battaglia et al., 2018 ) . However, their rules remain tied to environment-specific objects and can fail when familiar objects serve different functions. This suggests a functional view, as in affordance models relating objects, actions, and effects ( Montesano et al., 2008 ; Khetarpal et al., 2026 ) . We organize such functional knowledge for transfer by separating shared interaction mechanisms from the object–function assignments and parameters that can be revised online.
paragraphs.zh: 近期的方法利用大型语言模型（LLM）将世界动态表示为符号规则或可执行程序（Zhou 等，2025；Tang 等，2024a；Piriyakulkij 等，2025），其组合结构为重复使用提供了自然基础（Battaglia 等，2018）。 然而，这些规则仍然与特定环境中的对象绑定在一起，当熟悉的对象承担不同功能时，它们可能会失效。 这表明应采用一种功能性视角，例如在“可供性”模型中，该模型将对象、动作和效果关联起来（Montesano 等，2008；Khetarpal 等，2026）。 我们通过将共享的交互机制与可在线修订的对象–功能分配及参数分离开来，从而组织这类功能性知识以实现迁移。

paragraphs.en: To address this problem, we introduce RoleWorld , a symbolic world modeling approach that uses functional role abstractions to represent how objects behave in interactions. Each functional role abstraction consists of a reusable role prototype and environment-specific parameter values . This factorization separates reusable interaction functions from environment-specific object–function assignments and parameter values. As a result, the same role-level interaction structure can be reused when the objects realizing a function change across environments, while environment-specific differences are captured through role assignments and parameters. From trajectories collected in a source world, a teacher LLM extracts role prototypes and executable transition rules defined over role instances, together with a reusable skill for role-based decision making. Each transition rule captures an interaction mechanism whose requirements and effects are instantiated through concrete role instances. This formulation is intended to support reuse across environments where different objects instantiate the same role prototypes. In a target world, the actor LLM operates without the teacher, and the role prototypes, transition rules, and skill remain fixed. Guided by the skill, the actor uses the transition rules to predict action outcomes and select actions. When uncertainty about a role assignment could affect its decision, the actor gathers evidence through an informative interaction. Action feedback is then used to refine role assignments and parameter estimates online, allowing RoleWorld to adapt the environment-specific instantiation of its world model.
paragraphs.zh: 为解决这一问题，我们提出了 RoleWorld——一种符号化世界建模方法，它利用功能性角色抽象来表示物体在交互中的行为方式。 每个功能性角色抽象由一个可重用的角色原型和特定于环境的参数值组成。 这种分解将可重用的交互函数与特定于环境的物体-函数分配及参数值分离开来。 因此，当实现某一功能的物体在不同环境中发生变化时，相同角色层级的交互结构仍能被重复使用，而环境特定的差异则通过角色分配和参数加以捕捉。 从源世界中收集到的轨迹中，教师 LLM 会提取角色原型、定义在角色实例上的可执行转换规则，以及用于基于角色的决策的可重用技能。 每条转换规则都捕捉了一种交互机制，其需求和效果通过具体的角色实例得以实现。 这种设计旨在支持跨环境的重用，即使不同物体实现了相同角色原型也能适用。 在目标世界中，执行者 LLM 无需教师的指导即可运行，而角色原型、转换规则和技能则保持固定不变。 在技能的引导下，执行者利用转换规则预测行动结果并选择行动。 当角色分配的不确定性可能影响决策时，执行者会通过一次信息丰富的交互来收集证据。 随后，行动反馈会被用于在线优化角色分配和参数估计，使 RoleWorld 能够适应环境特定的世界模型实例化方式。

paragraphs.en: Object-centric abstractions support reuse beyond individual object identities. OO-MDPs and Schema Networks represent interaction rules and local causal schemas ( Diuk et al., 2008 ; Kansky et al., 2017 ) . James et al. (2022) learn object types and lifted planning models reusable across tasks sharing those types, while Marom and Rosman (2024) learn transferable transition and reward models. Adaptation can involve revising transferred code, as in WorldCoder ( Tang et al., 2024a ) , or inferring task-specific hidden parameters of shared dynamics, as in HiP-MDPs ( Doshi-Velez and Konidaris, 2016 ) . RoleWorld allows multiple compatible roles per object and adapts their assignments and instance parameters while holding role prototypes and transition rules fixed. We consider target-world changes expressible within this transferred library.
paragraphs.zh: 以对象为中心的抽象支持超越单个对象身份的复用。 OO-MDPs 和 Schema Networks 表示交互规则和局部因果模式（Diuk 等人，2008；Kansky 等人，2017）。James 等人 （2022）学习可在共享这些类型的任务间复用的对象类型和提升规划模型，而 Marom 和 Rosman（2024）则学习可迁移的转移和奖励模型。 适应可能涉及对转移代码的修订，如 WorldCoder（Tang 等人，2024a），或推断共享动态的任务特定隐藏参数，如 HiP-MDPs（Doshi-Velez 和 Konidaris，2016）。 RoleWorld 允许每个对象拥有多个兼容的角色，并在保持角色原型和转移规则不变的同时调整其分配和实例参数。 我们认为目标世界的变化可以在这一转移库的范围内表达。

paragraphs.en: Active model learning offers a way to resolve such uncertainty by selecting interactions that test hypotheses. WorldLLM ( Levy et al., 2025 ) combines Bayesian inference over natural-language hypotheses with curiosity-driven exploration. OPINE-World ( Courtis et al., 2026 ) combines program synthesis, hypothesis testing, and replay verification, using a Bayesian measure of object-type adequacy to guide exploration. In RoleWorld, a fixed skill guides such testing when uncertainty about a role instance hypothesis affects the current decision. Feedback refines role assignments and instance parameters while the prototypes and transition rules remain fixed, without further teacher calls.
paragraphs.zh: 主动模型学习通过选择能够检验假设的交互方式，为解决此类不确定性提供了一种方法。 WorldLLM（Levy 等人，2025）将自然语言假设上的贝叶斯推理与好奇心驱动的探索相结合。 OPINE-World（Courtis 等人，2026）结合了程序合成、假设检验和重播验证，并利用对对象类型充分性的贝叶斯度量来指导探索。 在 RoleWorld 中，当对角色实例假设的不确定性影响当前决策时，一种固定的技能会引导此类检验。 反馈会优化角色分配和实例参数，而原型和转换规则则保持固定，无需进一步调用教师模型。

paragraphs.en: RoleWorld uses functional role abstractions to separate reusable interaction structure from environment-specific instantiations. Our framework consists of three components. First, a teacher LLM constructs a symbolic world model in the source world, consisting of reusable role prototypes and executable transition rules defined over role instances. Second, in a target world, we infer and progressively refine object–role assignments and environment-specific parameter values from interaction feedback, while keeping the prototypes and transition rules fixed. Third, a reusable skill guides the actor to make decisions using current role estimates and transition rules, and to take actions to test those estimates when role uncertainty affects the current decision.
paragraphs.zh: RoleWorld 使用功能性角色抽象来将可重用的交互结构与特定环境的实例化分离。 我们的框架由三个组件组成。 首先，一个教师 LLM 在源世界中构建一个符号世界模型，该模型包含可重用的角色原型以及定义在角色实例上的可执行转换规则。 其次，在目标世界中，我们从交互反馈中推断并逐步优化对象与角色的分配以及特定环境的参数值，同时保持角色原型和转换规则不变。 第三，一个可重用的技能指导行动者利用当前的角色估计和转换规则做出决策，并在角色不确定性影响当前决策时采取行动来验证这些估计。

paragraphs.en: The teacher proposes candidate functions and jointly specifies their role prototypes and transition rules, including triggering events, participants, conditions, effects, and the required parameters and state variables. It executes candidate rules to compare their predicted observable outcomes with real trajectories and obtains additional evidence through environment-interaction tools when needed. To resolve discrepancies, it revises parameter values or rule conditions and effects, adding or splitting prototypes and their associated rules when an independent function requires a separate representation. It merges candidate prototypes and their transition rules when they share triggering events, participant structure, and condition–effect structure, with differences in concrete requirements and effects captured by the parameter values of role instances. Each structural revision is checked against accumulated interaction evidence. Appendix A.1 describes the construction procedure.
paragraphs.zh: 教师提出候选函数，并共同指定其角色原型和转换规则，包括触发事件、参与者、条件、效果以及所需的参数和状态变量。 它执行候选规则，将预测的可观察结果与实际轨迹进行比较，并在必要时通过环境交互工具获取额外证据。 为了解决差异，它会修订参数值或规则条件和效果；当独立函数需要单独表示时，则会添加或拆分原型及其相关规则。 当候选原型及其转换规则共享触发事件、参与者结构和条件-效果结构时，它会将它们合并，而具体要求和效果的差异则通过角色实例的参数值来体现。 每次结构修订都会与累积的交互证据进行核对。 附录 A.1 描述了构建过程。

paragraphs.en: With role prototypes and transition rules held fixed, online role inference estimates object–role assignments and environment-specific role parameters from interaction feedback. paragraphs.en: A prediction error does not necessarily imply an incorrect role type, since interaction outcomes also depend on environment-specific parameters. paragraphs.en: We evaluate RoleWorld in MARS ( Tang et al., 2024b ) , an open-world survival benchmark built on Crafter ( Hafner, 2022 ) . Agents pursue 22 achievements in a partially observable world using text observations of nearby objects and their coordinates, the agent’s status, and its inventory. MARS includes a Default world and seven variants that alter terrain, survival settings, and task dependencies, individually or in combination, while retaining Crafter’s objects and achievements. Changes such as hostile cows and stone yielding diamonds make object names unreliable indicators of behavior, testing adaptation to changed object functions. We compare RoleWorld with the MARS implementation of ReAct ( Yao et al., 2023 ; Tang et al., 2024b ) , which reasons before each action; Induction from Reflection (IFR) ( Tang et al., 2024b ) , which induces environment rules from trajectory reflections; and three world-model-based approaches: PoE-World ( Piriyakulkij et al., 2025 ) , WALL-E ( Zhou et al., 2025 ) , and WorldCoder ( Tang et al., 2024a ) .
paragraphs.zh: 我们在 MARS（Tang 等人，2024b）中评估了 RoleWorld，这是一个基于 Crafter（Hafner，2022）构建的开放世界生存基准。 智能体在一个部分可观察的世界中追求 22 项成就，其依据是对附近物体的文本描述及其坐标、智能体的状态以及其物品栏。 MARS 包含一个默认世界和七个变体，这些变体单独或组合地改变地形、生存设置和任务依赖关系，同时保留了 Crafter 的物体和成就。 诸如敌对奶牛和能产出钻石的石头等变化使得物体名称无法可靠地反映其行为，从而测试了智能体对物体功能变化的适应能力。 我们将 RoleWorld 与 MARS 中实现的 ReAct（Yao 等人，2023；Tang 等人，2024b）进行了比较，ReAct 在每次行动前都会进行推理；还与 Induction from Reflection（IFR）（Tang 等人，2024b）进行了比较，该方法通过轨迹反射推导出环境规则；以及三种基于世界模型的方法：PoE-World（Piriyakulkij 等人，2025）、WALL-E（Zhou 等人，2025）和 WorldCoder（Tang 等人，2024a）。

paragraphs.en: Table 1 distinguishes three stages: Source learning acquires knowledge in Default before transfer; Target learning acquires knowledge in each target world before evaluation; and Online refinement updates knowledge using feedback within each evaluation episode. We use two complementary comparisons to evaluate transfer. First, IFR, PoE-World, and WALL-E learn separately in each target world for five episodes before evaluation. This comparison tests whether RoleWorld can transfer knowledge from Default to achieve better task performance than baselines that learn in the target world. Second, WorldCoder and RoleWorld autonomously learn through interaction in Default, each with a source-learning budget of at most five episodes. Both enter target-world evaluation without target learning, providing a direct comparison of transfer performance. ReAct uses neither pre-evaluation learning stage.
paragraphs.zh: 表 1 区分了三个阶段：源学习在迁移前于默认环境中获取知识；目标学习在每次评估前于每个目标世界中获取知识；在线优化则利用反馈在每次评估回合内更新知识。 我们使用两种互补的比较方法来评估迁移效果。 首先，IFR、PoE-World 和 WALL-E 在每次评估前，于每个目标世界中分别学习五个回合。 这种比较旨在检验 RoleWorld 是否能够将知识从默认环境迁移到目标世界，从而比在目标世界中学习的基线模型取得更好的任务表现。 其次，WorldCoder 和 RoleWorld 在默认环境中通过交互自主学习，各自用于源学习的预算最多为五个回合。 两者在进入目标世界的评估阶段时均未进行目标学习，因此可以直接比较其迁移性能。 ReAct 并未使用任何评估前的学习阶段。

paragraphs.en: All LLM calls during source learning use GPT-5.6 Sol ( OpenAI, 2026 ) . WorldCoder constructs an executable world model. For RoleWorld, the teacher constructs role prototypes and transition rules, infers initial role assignments and parameter values, and develops the program that organizes role information for the actor. During target-world evaluation, WorldCoder refines its model code online, whereas RoleWorld refines only role assignments and environment-specific parameter estimates, keeping the prototypes, transition rules, and skill fixed. IFR continues to induce rules, PoE-World refines its experts and weights, and WALL-E refines symbolic knowledge.
paragraphs.zh: 源学习阶段的所有 LLM 调用均使用 GPT-5.6 Sol（OpenAI，2026）。 WorldCoder 构建一个可执行的世界模型。 对于 RoleWorld，教师构建角色原型和转换规则，推断初始的角色分配和参数值，并开发用于为执行者组织角色信息的程序。 在目标世界评估阶段，WorldCoder 在线优化其模型代码，而 RoleWorld 仅优化角色分配和环境特定的参数估计，同时保持原型、转换规则和技能不变。 IFR 持续生成规则，PoE-World 优化其专家和权重，而 WALL-E 则优化符号知识。

paragraphs.en: We use Qwen3-8B ( Yang et al., 2025 ) and GPT-5.6 Luna ( OpenAI, 2026 ) as target-world backbones. In each configuration, the designated backbone handles all LLM calls during target learning and evaluation, including action selection and knowledge refinement. Episodes in all three stages are limited to 1,000 environment steps. Learned knowledge is retained across episodes within source learning and target learning. Each evaluation episode starts from the same knowledge state obtained before evaluation for that method and world; interaction history and refinements made during one evaluation episode are not carried into another.

paragraphs.en: As shown in Table 2 , RoleWorld achieves the highest average reward across the seven variants with both backbones, demonstrating its effectiveness in supporting agent decision making across environments with altered dynamics. The advantage over WorldCoder under the same transfer protocol suggests that our role-based symbolic world model transfers more effectively across environments with changed object behavior.

paragraphs.en: We evaluate four ablations with Qwen3-8B under the same transfer protocol: w/o Skill retains online adaptation but removes the skill’s information organization and decision/verification guidance; w/o Adaptation freezes initial role assignments and parameter estimates; Fixed Role Assignments permits parameter refinement but freezes object–role assignments; and w/o Active Verification removes explicit verification guidance while retaining other decision support and online adaptation. Without the skill, the actor receives action requirements, predicted effects, and uncertainty from the highest-probability compatible combination of role instance hypotheses. We also compare Direct LLM , which acts without a separate reasoning step or role guidance, and RoleWorld (Symbolic Planner) , which replaces the actor with a hand-designed symbolic planner while retaining the same role representation and adaptation procedure. Implementation details appear in Appendices A.3 and A.4 .
paragraphs.zh: 我们在相同的迁移协议下，使用 Qwen3-8B 评估了四种消融实验：w/o Skill 保留了在线适应能力，但移除了技能的信息组织与决策/验证指导；w/o Adaptation 冻结了初始的角色分配和参数估计；Fixed Role Assignments 允许参数优化，但冻结了对象与角色的分配；而 w/o Active Verification 则移除了显式的验证指导，同时保留了其他决策支持和在线适应能力。 在没有技能的情况下，执行者会从概率最高的兼容角色实例假设组合中获取行动要求、预测效果和不确定性信息。 我们还对比了 Direct LLM（它无需独立的推理步骤或角色指导即可执行任务）以及 RoleWorld（Symbolic Planner）（它将执行者替换为人工设计的符号规划器，但保留了相同的角色表示和迁移流程）。 实现细节见附录 A.3 和 A.4。

paragraphs.en: As shown in Table 3 , the transferred role knowledge and skill provide a useful starting point for target-world decisions: w/o Adaptation achieves an average reward of 4.9, compared with 1.0 for Direct LLM . Online adaptation further increases average reward to 6.5, although freezing the source role estimates remains competitive in several variants. Thus, adaptation builds on a useful transferred prior, with benefits that vary across environments.
paragraphs.zh: 如表 3 所示，转移的角色知识与技能为目标世界中的决策提供了有用的起点：在“无自适应”（w/o Adaptation）的情况下，平均奖励为 4.9，而“直接 LLM”（Direct LLM）的平均奖励仅为 1.0。 在线自适应进一步将平均奖励提升至 6.5，尽管在某些变体中，冻结源角色估计值的方法仍然具有竞争力。 因此，自适应建立在了有用的转移先验知识之上，其带来的益处因环境不同而有所差异。

paragraphs.en: Although w/o Adaptation and Fixed Role Assignments both average 4.9 reward, per-world results suggest that parameter refinement and role reassignment are complementary, with neither consistently more important. On Terr. Surv., parameter refinement alone raises reward from 6.2 to 7.8, close to the full model’s 8.1. On Task Dep., it raises reward only from 0.9 to 1.4, versus 6.8 with role reassignment. On Terr. Task., reward rises from 4.3 to 5.4 with parameter refinement and further to 6.2 with role reassignment. These patterns are consistent with mismatches in parameter values, functional bindings, or both. On All Three, parameter refinement accounts for most of the gain (0.2 to 2.5, versus 3.0 for the full model), suggesting that role reassignment’s relative benefit does not necessarily increase as more environment factors change.
paragraphs.zh: 尽管“无适应”和“固定角色分配”两种方法的平均奖励均为 4.9，但各世界的具体结果表明，参数优化与角色重新分配是互补的，且两者并无一种始终更为重要。在“Terr. Surv.”中，仅通过参数优化即可将奖励从 6.2 提升至 7.8，接近完整模型的 8.1。在“Task Dep.”中，参数优化仅使奖励从 0.9 提升至 1.4，而角色重新分配则可使奖励达到 6.8。在“Terr. Task.”中，参数优化使奖励从 4.3 升至 5.4，而结合角色重新分配后，奖励进一步升至 6.2。这些模式与参数值、功能绑定或两者之间的不匹配相符。在“All Three”中，参数优化贡献了大部分增益（从 0.2 提升至 2.5，而完整模型为 3.0），这表明角色重新分配的相对收益并不会随着环境因素的变化而必然增加。

paragraphs.en: Realizing these benefits also requires guidance for using and testing role knowledge. Removing the skill reduces average reward to 1.2, close to Direct LLM . Retaining its decision support without active verification raises reward to 3.6, but this remains below w/o Adaptation . Together with the full model’s 6.5, these results support the joint use of online adaptation and active verification. Verification provides larger reward gains in variants with task-dependency changes, consistent with uncertain assumptions about role instances and interaction requirements affecting downstream decisions through prerequisite chains.

We evaluate each condition after the first 100 and 300 active interactions from actor-generated trajectories, reporting means over six random seeds.

paragraphs.en: The teacher constructs role prototypes and transition rules from source-world trajectories and additional interaction evidence. The role representation, DSL event vocabulary, condition and effect operators, and interpreter are provided in advance. This includes the execution semantics and event scheduling used to compose rules. Within this representation, the teacher selects the functional decomposition, declares parameters and state variables, and composes conditions and effects. These structural choices are made by the teacher; the interpreter executes the resulting rules. Environment-interaction tools allow the teacher to restore states, set controlled conditions, and execute actions. Evidence for induction consists of public observations before and after each action, together with the recorded intervention conditions.

paragraphs.en: The teacher compares observations before and after each action to identify candidate effects, retaining unsuccessful attempts and interactions with no observable change. For controlled interactions, the observation before the action is recorded after setting the experimental conditions, so changes made by the tools are excluded from the action’s effects. Comparisons with control conditions and no-operation actions help distinguish action effects from background changes. An observed difference alone does not establish which mechanism caused it. Likewise, an unchanged observation may reflect unmet conditions or a stochastic outcome, so it does not by itself eliminate a candidate function.
paragraphs.zh: 教师通过比较每次行动前后观察到的结果，来确定可能的效应，同时保留未成功的尝试以及没有可观察变化的互动。 对于受控互动，在设定实验条件后会记录行动前的观察结果，因此工具造成的变化不会被计入该行动的效应中。 与对照条件及无操作行动的对比有助于区分行动效应与背景变化。 仅凭观察到的差异本身，无法确定究竟是哪种机制导致了这种差异。 同样地，观察结果没有变化可能意味着条件未满足或属于随机结果，因此它本身并不能排除某个候选功能。

sents.zh: 教师通过比较每次行动前后观察到的结果，来确定可能的效应，同时保留未成功的尝试以及没有可观察变化的互动。

sents.en: For controlled interactions, the observation before the action is recorded after setting the experimental conditions, so changes made by the tools are excluded from the action’s effects.
sents.zh: 对于受控互动，在设定实验条件后会记录行动前的观察结果，因此工具造成的变化不会被计入该行动的效应中。

sents.zh: 与对照条件及无操作行动的对比有助于区分行动效应与背景变化。

sents.zh: 仅凭观察到的差异本身，无法确定究竟是哪种机制导致了这种差异。

sents.zh: 同样地，观察结果没有变化可能意味着条件未满足或属于随机结果，因此它本身并不能排除某个候选功能。

paragraphs.en: For each candidate mechanism, the teacher selects a triggering event event \mathrm{event} from the predefined vocabulary and specifies participant variables and their required role prototypes in P τ P_{\tau} . Successful and unsuccessful interactions constrain the applicability condition g τ g_{\tau} . The effects F τ F_{\tau} specify the resulting state changes and interaction outcomes, including dependencies among effects and conditions under which they occur. Effects that share a stochastic outcome are represented jointly, preserving which changes occur together. Outcome probabilities are estimated from repeated interactions under the corresponding conditions; observations of only successful outcomes support a deterministic modeling assumption, rather than proving that the underlying probability is one.
paragraphs.zh: 对于每个候选机制，教师会从预定义词汇表中选择一个触发事件 event \mathrm{event}，并在 P τ P_{\tau} 中指定参与者变量及其所需的角色原型。 成功和失败的交互会约束适用性条件 g τ g_{\tau}。 效应 F τ F_{\tau} 规定了由此产生的状态变化和交互结果，包括效应之间的依赖关系以及它们发生所需的条件。 共享随机结果的效应会被联合表示，从而保留哪些变化会同时发生。 结果概率通过在对应条件下重复交互进行估计；仅观察到成功结果的情况支持确定性建模假设，而非证明其底层概率为 1。

sents.en: For each candidate mechanism, the teacher selects a triggering event event \mathrm{event} from the predefined vocabulary and specifies participant variables and their required role prototypes in P τ P_{\tau} .
sents.zh: 对于每个候选机制，教师会从预定义词汇表中选择一个触发事件 event \mathrm{event}，并在 P τ P_{\tau} 中指定参与者变量及其所需的角色原型。

sents.en: Effects that share a stochastic outcome are represented jointly, preserving which changes occur together.
sents.zh: 共享随机结果的效应会被联合表示，从而保留哪些变化会同时发生。

sents.en: Outcome probabilities are estimated from repeated interactions under the corresponding conditions; observations of only successful outcomes support a deterministic modeling assumption, rather than proving that the underlying probability is one.
sents.zh: 结果概率通过在对应条件下重复交互进行估计；仅观察到成功结果的情况支持确定性建模假设，而非证明其底层概率为 1。

paragraphs.en: The teacher synchronizes these rules with the associated prototypes. Parameters describe interaction requirements and effects that are fixed for an object within an environment, with values in Θ ρ \Theta_{\rho} ; state variables describe properties that evolve through interaction, with values in 𝒳 ρ \mathcal{X}_{\rho} . Candidate parameter values are supported by the interaction evidence. Each declared parameter or state variable must be referenced by at least one transition condition or effect. Thus, constructing a prototype includes determining the variables required by its rules, and revising a rule may require corresponding changes to the prototype.
paragraphs.zh: 教师将这些规则与相关的原型同步。 参数描述了在环境中某个对象内固定的交互要求和效果，其值属于 Θ ρ \Theta_{\rho}；状态变量则描述了通过交互演变的属性，其值属于 𝒳 ρ \mathcal{X}_{\rho}。 候选参数值由交互证据所支持。 每个声明的参数或状态变量都必须被至少一个转换条件或效果引用。 因此，构建原型包括确定其规则所需的变量，而修改某个规则可能需要对原型进行相应调整。

sents.en: The teacher synchronizes these rules with the associated prototypes.
sents.zh: 教师将这些规则与相关的原型同步。

sents.en: Parameters describe interaction requirements and effects that are fixed for an object within an environment, with values in Θ ρ \Theta_{\rho} ; state variables describe properties that evolve through interaction, with values in 𝒳 ρ \mathcal{X}_{\rho} .
sents.zh: 参数描述了在环境中某个对象内固定的交互要求和效果，其值属于 Θ ρ \Theta_{\rho}；状态变量则描述了通过交互演变的属性，其值属于 𝒳 ρ \mathcal{X}_{\rho}。

sents.en: Candidate parameter values are supported by the interaction evidence.
sents.zh: 候选参数值由交互证据所支持。

sents.en: Each declared parameter or state variable must be referenced by at least one transition condition or effect.
sents.zh: 每个声明的参数或状态变量都必须被至少一个转换条件或效果引用。

sents.en: Thus, constructing a prototype includes determining the variables required by its rules, and revising a rule may require corresponding changes to the prototype.
sents.zh: 因此，构建原型包括确定其规则所需的变量，而修改某个规则可能需要对原型进行相应调整。

paragraphs.en: The teacher first checks whether a discrepancy can be explained by parameter values within the current prototype and transition structure. Assigning an existing prototype to another object also requires no new functional definition. If the same function instead needs an additional applicability condition or a revised outcome structure, the teacher modifies its transition rules and any required parameter or state declarations. A new or split prototype is introduced when an independent function requires a separate description of its events, participants, conditions, or effects; the associated transition rules are constructed at the same time. A failed parameter revision therefore does not automatically imply a new prototype. Functions that coexist independently on the same object remain separate, with 𝒞 ρ \mathcal{C}_{\rho} specifying which prototypes may be instantiated together.
paragraphs.zh: 教师首先检查是否存在差异，并判断这种差异是否可以通过当前原型和转换结构中的参数值来解释。 将现有原型分配给另一个对象时，同样不需要新的功能定义。 如果同一功能反而需要额外的适用性条件或修订后的结果结构，教师则会修改其转换规则以及任何必需的参数或状态声明。 当一个独立功能需要对其事件、参与者、条件或效应进行单独描述时，就会引入一个新的或拆分后的原型；相关的转换规则也会同时构建。 因此，参数修订失败并不自动意味着需要创建新的原型。 在同一个对象上独立共存的功能仍然保持分离，其中 𝒞 ρ \mathcal{C}_{\rho} 用于指定哪些原型可以被同时实例化。

sents.en: The teacher first checks whether a discrepancy can be explained by parameter values within the current prototype and transition structure.
sents.zh: 教师首先检查是否存在差异，并判断这种差异是否可以通过当前原型和转换结构中的参数值来解释。

sents.zh: 将现有原型分配给另一个对象时，同样不需要新的功能定义。

sents.zh: 如果同一功能反而需要额外的适用性条件或修订后的结果结构，教师则会修改其转换规则以及任何必需的参数或状态声明。

sents.en: A new or split prototype is introduced when an independent function requires a separate description of its events, participants, conditions, or effects; the associated transition rules are constructed at the same time.
sents.zh: 当一个独立功能需要对其事件、参与者、条件或效应进行单独描述时，就会引入一个新的或拆分后的原型；相关的转换规则也会同时构建。

sents.en: A failed parameter revision therefore does not automatically imply a new prototype.
sents.zh: 因此，参数修订失败并不自动意味着需要创建新的原型。

sents.en: Functions that coexist independently on the same object remain separate, with 𝒞 ρ \mathcal{C}_{\rho} specifying which prototypes may be instantiated together.
sents.zh: 在同一个对象上独立共存的功能仍然保持分离，其中 𝒞 ρ \mathcal{C}_{\rho} 用于指定哪些原型可以被同时实例化。

paragraphs.en: The teacher merges candidates when their triggering events, participant structure, and condition–effect structure can be shared, including the temporal relationships and dependencies among outcomes. Object-specific constants become parameters, supported values enter the parameter domains, and each object’s complete parameter combination is retained in its source-world role instance. The associated transition rules are merged at the same time: prototype references, participant requirements, and parameter or state references are updated, and superseded rules are removed to avoid executing duplicate effects. Similar outputs or coexistence on the same object are insufficient grounds for a merge. Distinct conditions or temporal relationships must remain explicit as conditional branches or separate functions.
paragraphs.zh: 当候选智能体的触发事件、参与者结构以及条件-结果结构可以共享时，包括结果之间的时间关系和依赖关系，这些候选智能体就会被合并。 特定于对象的常量变为参数，受支持的值进入参数域，而每个对象完整的参数组合则保留在其源世界角色实例中。 相关的转换规则也会同时被合并：原型引用、参与者要求以及参数或状态引用会被更新，而被取代的规则则会被移除，以避免执行重复的效果。 相似的结果或在同一对象上的共存并不足以成为合并的依据。 不同的条件或时间关系必须作为条件分支或独立函数明确保留。

sents.en: The teacher merges candidates when their triggering events, participant structure, and condition–effect structure can be shared, including the temporal relationships and dependencies among outcomes.
sents.zh: 当候选智能体的触发事件、参与者结构以及条件-结果结构可以共享时，包括结果之间的时间关系和依赖关系，这些候选智能体就会被合并。

sents.zh: 特定于对象的常量变为参数，受支持的值进入参数域，而每个对象完整的参数组合则保留在其源世界角色实例中。

sents.en: The associated transition rules are merged at the same time: prototype references, participant requirements, and parameter or state references are updated, and superseded rules are removed to avoid executing duplicate effects.
sents.zh: 相关的转换规则也会同时被合并：原型引用、参与者要求以及参数或状态引用会被更新，而被取代的规则则会被移除，以避免执行重复的效果。

sents.en: Similar outputs or coexistence on the same object are insufficient grounds for a merge.
sents.zh: 相似的结果或在同一对象上的共存并不足以成为合并的依据。

sents.en: Distinct conditions or temporal relationships must remain explicit as conditional branches or separate functions.
sents.zh: 不同的条件或时间关系必须作为条件分支或独立函数明确保留。

paragraphs.en: The interpreter executes candidate rules using the observed state before the action and the parameter values of the corresponding role instances, composing applicable rules according to the predefined DSL semantics. Predictions are compared with the complete observable effects covered by the candidate model, including quantities or fields expected to remain unchanged. Deterministic predictions are checked for agreement with these effects. For stochastic predictions, checking whether an observation lies in the predicted support is distinct from comparing predicted probabilities with empirical outcome frequencies. Missing effects, extra effects, incorrect conditions, and incorrect dependencies among outcomes provide counterexamples for revising the model.
paragraphs.zh: 解释器使用动作发生前的观测状态和相应角色实例的参数值来执行候选规则，并根据预定义的 DSL 语义组合出适用的规则。 预测结果会与候选模型所涵盖的全部可观测效应进行比较，包括预期保持不变的量或字段。 确定性预测会被检查是否与这些效应一致。 对于随机性预测，判断某个观测值是否位于预测的支持集中，与比较预测概率和实际结果频率是不同的。 缺失的效应、多余的效应、错误的条件以及结果之间的错误依赖关系，都为模型修订提供了反例。

sents.en: The interpreter executes candidate rules using the observed state before the action and the parameter values of the corresponding role instances, composing applicable rules according to the predefined DSL semantics.
sents.zh: 解释器使用动作发生前的观测状态和相应角色实例的参数值来执行候选规则，并根据预定义的 DSL 语义组合出适用的规则。

sents.zh: 预测结果会与候选模型所涵盖的全部可观测效应进行比较，包括预期保持不变的量或字段。

sents.en: Deterministic predictions are checked for agreement with these effects.
sents.zh: 确定性预测会被检查是否与这些效应一致。

sents.en: For stochastic predictions, checking whether an observation lies in the predicted support is distinct from comparing predicted probabilities with empirical outcome frequencies.
sents.zh: 对于随机性预测，判断某个观测值是否位于预测的支持集中，与比较预测概率和实际结果频率是不同的。

sents.zh: 缺失的效应、多余的效应、错误的条件以及结果之间的错误依赖关系，都为模型修订提供了反例。

paragraphs.en: After a structural revision, the teacher checks the affected rules against accumulated successful and unsuccessful interactions. Parameterization and merging are also checked for preservation of the predicted outcome distributions on the recorded inputs. This check evaluates whether the revised representation preserves the candidate mechanisms on those inputs; it supplies no independent evidence for their correctness on unobserved inputs. Additional controlled interactions can distinguish competing explanations. The model is frozen before checking it on held-out interactions, which are not used to select its structure or estimate its parameters.
paragraphs.zh: 经过结构修订后，教师会将受影响的规则与累积的成功和失败互动进行核对。 同时也会检查参数化和合并操作是否保留了记录输入上预测的结果分布。 这项检查评估修订后的表示是否在那些输入上保留了候选机制；但它并未为这些机制在未观察输入上的正确性提供任何独立证据。 额外的受控互动可以区分相互竞争的解释。 在模型于预留互动上进行检验之前，会将其冻结；这些互动未被用于选择其结构或估计其参数。

sents.en: After a structural revision, the teacher checks the affected rules against accumulated successful and unsuccessful interactions.
sents.zh: 经过结构修订后，教师会将受影响的规则与累积的成功和失败互动进行核对。

sents.en: Parameterization and merging are also checked for preservation of the predicted outcome distributions on the recorded inputs.
sents.zh: 同时也会检查参数化和合并操作是否保留了记录输入上预测的结果分布。

sents.en: This check evaluates whether the revised representation preserves the candidate mechanisms on those inputs; it supplies no independent evidence for their correctness on unobserved inputs.
sents.zh: 这项检查评估修订后的表示是否在那些输入上保留了候选机制；但它并未为这些机制在未观察输入上的正确性提供任何独立证据。

sents.en: Additional controlled interactions can distinguish competing explanations.
sents.zh: 额外的受控互动可以区分相互竞争的解释。

sents.en: The model is frozen before checking it on held-out interactions, which are not used to select its structure or estimate its parameters.
sents.zh: 在模型于预留互动上进行检验之前，会将其冻结；这些互动未被用于选择其结构或估计其参数。

paragraphs.en: The retained prototypes define reusable functions and their parameter and state spaces; the transition rules give their executable behavior. Source-world role assignments and parameter values are retained separately as the initial role prior, using the formats in Appendix A.2 . In the target world, prototypes and transition rules remain fixed while role assignments and parameter estimates are refined online. The construction establishes an evidence-supported representation within the observed conditions and the supplied DSL; finite trajectories need not uniquely determine the functional decomposition.
paragraphs.zh: 保留的原型定义了可重用的函数及其参数和状态空间；转换规则则给出了这些函数的可执行行为。 源世界中的角色分配和参数值被分别保留为初始角色先验，其格式遵循附录 A.2 的规定。 在目标世界中，原型和转换规则保持固定，而角色分配和参数估计则在线进行优化。 这一构建过程在观测条件下和所提供的 DSL 中建立了一个有证据支持的代表性模型；有限的轨迹并不必然唯一地确定功能分解。

sents.en: The retained prototypes define reusable functions and their parameter and state spaces; the transition rules give their executable behavior.
sents.zh: 保留的原型定义了可重用的函数及其参数和状态空间；转换规则则给出了这些函数的可执行行为。

sents.en: Source-world role assignments and parameter values are retained separately as the initial role prior, using the formats in Appendix A.2 .
sents.zh: 源世界中的角色分配和参数值被分别保留为初始角色先验，其格式遵循附录 A.2 的规定。

sents.en: In the target world, prototypes and transition rules remain fixed while role assignments and parameter estimates are refined online.
sents.zh: 在目标世界中，原型和转换规则保持固定，而角色分配和参数估计则在线进行优化。

paragraphs.en: Each role prototype defines a reusable function, the compatible prototypes that may be instantiated on the same object, and the parameter and state spaces of its instances. Parameters describe properties that are fixed for a given object within an environment; state variables track quantities that can change during interaction.
paragraphs.zh: 每个角色原型都定义了一个可重用的函数、可以在同一对象上实例化的兼容原型，以及其实例的参数和状态空间。 参数描述了在特定环境中对于给定对象而言固定的属性；状态变量则用于跟踪在交互过程中可能变化的量。

sents.en: Each role prototype defines a reusable function, the compatible prototypes that may be instantiated on the same object, and the parameter and state spaces of its instances.
sents.zh: 每个角色原型都定义了一个可重用的函数、可以在同一对象上实例化的兼容原型，以及其实例的参数和状态空间。

sents.en: Each rule specifies a triggering event, participant aliases with their required role prototypes, an applicability condition, and effects.

paragraphs.en: The four component ablations in Table 3 use Qwen3-8B in the seven non-Default MARS worlds, with the same source-world prior, role prototypes, and executable transition rules as the full method. paragraphs.en: We retain online role inference and refinement and query the same transition model for available actions, including hypothetical do interactions after approaching and facing other visible object types. For each query, a fixed filter selects the compatible combination of role instance hypotheses with the highest probability mass. It presents preconditions, effect quantities and conditional probabilities, current outcome predictions, verification status, and unknowns. Hypothesis probability mass and action-effect probabilities are displayed separately. Rules with mismatched action conditions or no effects are omitted, together with internal parameter tables and repeated evidence. We remove both the program-generated decision guidance and the fixed textual skill instructions. The remaining presentation does not rank information by task or history, resolve prerequisite chains, or provide navigation and retry suggestions. The actor still receives its observation and action-feedback history, and its chosen actions continue to supply evidence for online adaptation.
paragraphs.zh: 我们保留在线角色推断与优化机制，并向同一转换模型查询可用动作，包括在接近并面对其他可见对象类型后可能执行的假设性操作。 每次查询时，一个固定过滤器会选出与角色实例假设兼容且概率质量最高的组合。 该界面会显示前提条件、效果数量与条件概率、当前结果预测、验证状态以及未知项。 假设的概率质量与动作-效果概率将分开显示。 动作条件不匹配或无效果的规则将被省略，同时也会省略内部参数表和重复证据。 我们移除了程序生成的决策引导和固定的文本技能说明。 剩余的信息展示不会按任务或历史排序，也不会解决前提条件链问题，更不会提供导航或重试建议。 执行者仍会收到其观察结果与动作反馈的历史记录，且其选择的动作将继续为在线适应提供证据。

paragraphs.en: At every decision, we construct the role-query interface from a fresh copy of the initial source-world prior and populate it with the current observed state. Interaction evidence does not revise role assignments, parameter hypotheses, their weights, or verification status. Prior assignments retain their initial unverified status. The full skill, including its active-verification guidance, remains available. Current observations, inventory, status, observed movement, and action history are still supplied, allowing the skill to respond to changed conditions and previous failures. Thus, the frozen component is the persistent role knowledge; the decision input continues to reflect the ongoing episode.
paragraphs.zh: 在每次决策时，我们都会从初始源世界先验的一个全新副本中构建角色查询接口，并将其填充为当前观测到的状态。 交互证据不会修改角色分配、参数假设、其权重或验证状态。 先验分配保持其初始的未验证状态。 完整的技能（包括其主动验证引导）仍然可用。 当前的观测结果、库存、状态、观测到的移动和行动历史仍会被提供，使该技能能够响应变化的条件和之前的失败。 因此，被冻结的部分是持续存在的角色知识；决策输入则继续反映当前正在进行的回合。

paragraphs.en: We fix each object’s assigned prototype set to its initial assignments and disable the addition, removal, and replacement of assigned prototypes. Interaction feedback still refines parameter values and hypothesis weights within the assigned prototypes. For example, the model can revise the yield or requirements of an assigned resource-provider role instance. In this implementation, role verification status and event-support flags also remain at their initial values. The full skill, current observations, action history, and verification-related information are retained. This condition therefore permits parameter refinement within the prior assignments while keeping the functional assignments and their verification status fixed.
paragraphs.zh: 我们将每个对象所分配的原型集固定为其初始分配值，并禁用对已分配原型的添加、移除和替换操作。 交互反馈仍会在已分配的原型范围内优化参数值和假设权重。 例如，模型可以修改已分配的资源提供者角色实例的产出或要求。 在此实现中，角色验证状态和事件支持标志也保持其初始值不变。 完整的技能、当前观察结果、行动历史以及与验证相关的信息均被保留。 因此，该条件允许在先前分配的基础上优化参数，同时保持功能分配及其验证状态的固定不变。

paragraphs.en: We retain the skill’s ordinary decision support and full online adaptation but remove its explicit support for active verification. In the full method, the skill provides role instance hypotheses and their probabilities, verification status, interaction evidence, and action requirements and predicted effects. Using this information alongside its observations and task priorities, the actor decides whether verification is useful and which interaction, if any, to perform. Ordinary action descriptions in the ablation use the highest-probability compatible candidate. Prerequisite planning, exploration to find missing materials or stations, risk indications, and failure history are retained. The actor remains free to choose any available action, including an uncertain interaction, and feedback from its actions continues to update role assignments and parameter estimates. This ablation evaluates the contribution of the skill’s support for the actor’s own verification decisions.
paragraphs.zh: 我们保留了该技能的常规决策支持和完整的在线适应能力，但移除了其对主动验证的显式支持。 在完整方法中，该技能会提供角色实例假设及其概率、验证状态、交互证据、行动要求以及预测效果。 演员会结合这些信息、其观察结果和任务优先级，判断验证是否有用，以及是否执行某种交互。 在消融实验中，常规行动描述会使用概率最高的兼容候选项。 前提规划、寻找缺失材料或站点的探索、风险提示以及失败历史均被保留。 演员仍然可以自由选择任何可用行动（包括不确定的交互），其行动带来的反馈也会持续更新角色分配和参数估计。 该消融实验旨在评估该技能对演员自身验证决策的支持所做出的贡献。

paragraphs.en: For RoleWorld (Symbolic Planner), we replace the LLM actor with a hand-designed symbolic planner that operates on inferred role instances. The role prototypes, executable transition rules, and online role inference and refinement procedure are retained. We evaluate this variant on the same seven MARS variants, with reward and score reported in Table 3 .
paragraphs.zh: 对于 RoleWorld（符号规划器），我们将 LLM 智能体替换为一种手动设计的符号规划器，该规划器基于推断出的角色实例进行运作。 角色原型、可执行的转换规则以及在线角色推断与优化流程均被保留。 我们在相同的七个 MARS 变体上对该版本进行了评估，其奖励和分数在表 3 中列出。

sents.en: For RoleWorld (Symbolic Planner), we replace the LLM actor with a hand-designed symbolic planner that operates on inferred role instances.
sents.zh: 对于 RoleWorld（符号规划器），我们将 LLM 智能体替换为一种手动设计的符号规划器，该规划器基于推断出的角色实例进行运作。

sents.zh: 角色原型、可执行的转换规则以及在线角色推断与优化流程均被保留。

paragraphs.en: At each step, the planner associates observed objects and remembered terrain with their current role assignments. For ordinary planning, each assigned prototype is instantiated with its highest-probability parameter hypothesis. The shared transition rules then provide action descriptions consisting of an action, its preconditions, and its predicted effects. These include resource requirements, proximity to workstations, inventory and status changes, object creation, and achievement progress. The planner interprets the DSL condition and effect vocabulary; prototype identifiers select the corresponding inferred role instances for each object. Thus, concrete object functions and interaction requirements enter planning through the current role estimates.
paragraphs.zh: 在每个步骤中，规划器都将观察到的物体和记忆中的地形与它们当前的角色分配关联起来。 对于常规规划，每个分配的原型都会根据其概率最高的参数假设进行实例化。 共享的转换规则随后提供动作描述，包括一个动作、其前提条件和其预测效果。 这些包括资源需求、与工作站的位置关系、库存和状态变化、物体创建以及成就进度。 规划器会解释 DSL 的条件和效果词汇表；原型标识符则为每个物体选择对应的推断出的角色实例。 因此，具体的物体功能和交互需求会通过当前的角色估计进入规划过程。

sents.zh: 在每个步骤中，规划器都将观察到的物体和记忆中的地形与它们当前的角色分配关联起来。

sents.en: Thus, concrete object functions and interaction requirements enter planning through the current role estimates.
sents.zh: 因此，具体的物体功能和交互需求会通过当前的角色估计进入规划过程。

paragraphs.en: A fixed goal scheduler prioritizes survival and recovery, followed by unfinished achievements. The planner matches a desired outcome to a role-instantiated transition effect and recursively resolves unmet prerequisites. For example, to obtain a resource, it finds an interaction predicted to increase that resource, then plans how to acquire any required tools or establish access to a required workstation. Each dependency is read from the transition conditions and linked to another action through its predicted effects. Resource and achievement plans are compared using action cost and the predicted probability of the desired effect, while a feasible ongoing achievement target is retained. Navigation searches over position and facing on a map accumulated from observations, using role-derived traversability and risk estimates from inferred role instances and interaction history.
paragraphs.zh: 固定目标调度器优先处理生存和恢复，其次是未完成的成就。 规划器将期望结果与通过角色实例化的转换效果进行匹配，并递归解决未满足的先决条件。 例如，为了获取某种资源，它会找到一种预测中能够增加该资源的交互方式，然后规划如何获取任何所需的工具或建立对所需工作站的使用权限。 每个依赖项都从转换条件中读取，并通过其预测效果与另一个动作关联起来。 资源和成就计划通过动作成本以及期望效果的预测概率进行比较，同时保留一个可行的持续成就目标。 导航在基于观察积累下来的地图上搜索位置和朝向，使用由角色推导出的可通行性，以及从推断出的角色实例和交互历史中获得的风险分析估计。

sents.zh: 固定目标调度器优先处理生存和恢复，其次是未完成的成就。

sents.en: The planner matches a desired outcome to a role-instantiated transition effect and recursively resolves unmet prerequisites.
sents.zh: 规划器将期望结果与通过角色实例化的转换效果进行匹配，并递归解决未满足的先决条件。

sents.en: For example, to obtain a resource, it finds an interaction predicted to increase that resource, then plans how to acquire any required tools or establish access to a required workstation.
sents.zh: 例如，为了获取某种资源，它会找到一种预测中能够增加该资源的交互方式，然后规划如何获取任何所需的工具或建立对所需工作站的使用权限。

sents.en: Each dependency is read from the transition conditions and linked to another action through its predicted effects.
sents.zh: 每个依赖项都从转换条件中读取，并通过其预测效果与另一个动作关联起来。

sents.en: Resource and achievement plans are compared using action cost and the predicted probability of the desired effect, while a feasible ongoing achievement target is retained.
sents.zh: 资源和成就计划通过动作成本以及期望效果的预测概率进行比较，同时保留一个可行的持续成就目标。

sents.en: Navigation searches over position and facing on a map accumulated from observations, using role-derived traversability and risk estimates from inferred role instances and interaction history.
sents.zh: 导航在基于观察积累下来的地图上搜索位置和朝向，使用由角色推导出的可通行性，以及从推断出的角色实例和交互历史中获得的风险分析估计。

paragraphs.en: When ordinary goal plans are blocked, the planner can test goal-relevant role instance hypotheses or unverified interaction prerequisites. It compares candidate predictions of observable outcomes and ranks informative tests by expected information gain per action cost, subject to survival constraints. When no goal or verification plan is available, it explores the frontier of the observed map. The planner executes only the first action of each plan, records its prediction before execution, and compares it with the resulting feedback. The same interaction feedback updates role assignments and parameter estimates through the online inference procedure. The next decision uses the refreshed role information to compute a new plan. Throughout this process, the role prototypes and transition rules remain fixed, while revised role estimates can change both the selected objects and the prerequisite chains used to reach a goal.
paragraphs.zh: 当常规目标计划受阻时，规划器可以测试与目标相关的角色实例假设或未经验证的交互前提条件。 它会比较可观察结果的候选预测，并根据每次行动成本所期望的信息增益，在满足生存约束的前提下对具有信息价值的测试进行排序。 当没有可用的目标或验证计划时，它会探索已观察地图的边界区域。 规划器仅执行每个计划中的第一个行动，在执行前记录其预测结果，并将其与最终反馈进行比较。 相同的交互反馈会通过在线推理过程更新角色分配和参数估计值。 下一个决策将使用更新后的角色信息来计算新的计划。 在整个过程中，角色原型和转换规则保持不变，而修订后的角色估计值可能会改变所选对象以及达成目标所用的前提条件链。

paragraphs.en: For parameter corruption, the four levels alter 33, 55, 77, or 99 fields while retaining all bindings. Fields are sampled without replacement from the 104 fields that admit an incorrect value in their declared domains, including action-valued fields; the six fields with singleton domains remain unchanged. Each selected field receives a uniformly sampled incorrect value. The role assignment corruption protocol selects 9, 15, 21, or 27 assignments. In each selected assignment, the correct role type is replaced by a randomly sampled incorrect type from the prototype library, and the replacement prototype’s parameters are sampled independently from their respective declared domains. Unselected assignments retain their reference role types and parameter values. For each of six seeds, a random ordering of eligible fields or assignments defines nested corruption sets, so a higher level includes the changes at lower levels. Each condition starts from its own corrupted copy of the reference prior.

paragraphs.en: We count active interactions by the agent’s verification attempts. Each active interaction consists of an action selected by the agent to test an uncertain role assignment, parameter value, or interaction prerequisite, together with its observed outcome. Actions used only for navigation or routine resource acquisition do not contribute to this count. A movement action selected to verify traversability is counted, and both successful and unsuccessful verification attempts are retained.

paragraphs.en: Role parameter accuracy uses all 110 reference fields as a fixed denominator, with equal weight per field. Missing fields and all reference fields associated with a missing or incorrect role assignment count as incorrect. A list-valued parameter is evaluated as one field; order is ignored for resource requirements, resource costs, workstation requirements, and allowed surfaces. When several parameter hypotheses share the highest probability, a field counts as correct only if it matches the reference in every tied hypothesis. Role-type accuracy is evaluated over all 30 reference object–role assignments and checks whether the inferred role types match the reference, independently of parameter accuracy.
paragraphs.zh: 角色参数准确性使用全部 110 个参考字段作为固定分母，每个字段的权重相等。 缺失的字段以及与缺失或不正确的角色分配相关的所有参考字段均被视为不正确。 列表型参数按一个字段进行评估；对于资源需求、资源成本、工作站需求和允许的表面，顺序会被忽略。 当多个参数假设共享最高概率时，一个字段只有在所有并列的假设中都与参考值匹配时，才被视为正确。 角色类型准确性基于全部 30 个参考对象–角色分配进行评估，并检查推断出的角色类型是否与参考值匹配，该评估独立于参数准确性。

paragraphs.en: All 19 stochastic cases involve grass harvesting with a predicted drop probability of 50%. Per-case frequencies range from 47.8% to 52.9%, and the predicted probability lies within the corresponding pointwise 95% interval in all 19 cases. Mean empirical TV over these cases is 1.2632%. paragraphs.en: To check whether the evaluation can reveal errors, we independently introduce seven single changes to the reference prior: remove the tree/R1 assignment; require a wooden pickaxe for harvesting trees; change the wood cost of a wooden pickaxe to two; remove the workstation requirement for crafting an iron pickaxe; allow planting on sand; change the grass drop probability from 0.5 to 0.1; or change the drink quantity limit to eight. The drop-probability change raises mean TV over the 19 stochastic cases from 1.2632% to 40.5368%. All seven error types are detected through their corresponding scenarios.

paragraphs.en: We additionally collect six trajectories from normal spawn states using independent environment seeds and uniformly random actions, with a limit of 300 steps per trajectory and termination on death. Resources are not prepared, NPCs remain present, and the prior neither selects actions nor learns from feedback. The trajectories contain 1,140 transitions and visit 15 of the 30 assignments: R0–R3 predictions are available for 787 transitions, and 113 of these have observed effects outside the predicted support. The remaining 353 transitions comprise 222 steps in sleeping states, 122 actions outside the 30 assignments, and nine object interactions. We retain all transitions, including background changes and cases without predictions. The mean multiclass Brier score is 0.825439 when unavailable predictions receive the maximum penalty of two. This diagnostic reflects both prediction quality and coverage of R0–R3; its discrepancies cannot be interpreted directly as parameter errors in these assignments or as a measure of the entire prior’s predictive accuracy, since joint prediction with other role instances is not implemented here.
paragraphs.zh: 我们还使用独立的环境种子和均匀随机动作，从正常生成状态收集了六条轨迹，每条轨迹最多 300 步，并在死亡时终止。 资源未作准备，NPC 仍然存在，而先验既不会选择动作，也不会从反馈中学习。 这些轨迹包含 1,140 个转换，并访问了 30 个分配中的 15 个：R0–R3 的预测对 787 个转换可用，其中 113 个在预测支持范围之外观察到了影响。 其余 353 个转换包括 222 步处于睡眠状态、122 个不在 30 个分配内的动作以及九次对象交互。 我们保留了所有转换，包括背景变化以及没有预测的情况。 当不可用的预测获得最大惩罚值 2 时，多类别布里尔得分的平均值为 0.825439。 这一诊断既反映了预测质量，也反映了 R0–R3 的覆盖范围；其差异不能直接解释为这些分配中参数的错误，也不能视为整个先验预测准确性的衡量，因为此处并未实现与其他角色实例的联合预测。

sents.en: We additionally collect six trajectories from normal spawn states using independent environment seeds and uniformly random actions, with a limit of 300 steps per trajectory and termination on death.
sents.zh: 我们还使用独立的环境种子和均匀随机动作，从正常生成状态收集了六条轨迹，每条轨迹最多 300 步，并在死亡时终止。

sents.en: Resources are not prepared, NPCs remain present, and the prior neither selects actions nor learns from feedback.
sents.zh: 资源未作准备，NPC 仍然存在，而先验既不会选择动作，也不会从反馈中学习。

sents.en: The trajectories contain 1,140 transitions and visit 15 of the 30 assignments: R0–R3 predictions are available for 787 transitions, and 113 of these have observed effects outside the predicted support.
sents.zh: 这些轨迹包含 1,140 个转换，并访问了 30 个分配中的 15 个：R0–R3 的预测对 787 个转换可用，其中 113 个在预测支持范围之外观察到了影响。

sents.en: The remaining 353 transitions comprise 222 steps in sleeping states, 122 actions outside the 30 assignments, and nine object interactions.
sents.zh: 其余 353 个转换包括 222 步处于睡眠状态、122 个不在 30 个分配内的动作以及九次对象交互。

sents.en: We retain all transitions, including background changes and cases without predictions.
sents.zh: 我们保留了所有转换，包括背景变化以及没有预测的情况。

sents.en: The mean multiclass Brier score is 0.825439 when unavailable predictions receive the maximum penalty of two.
sents.zh: 当不可用的预测获得最大惩罚值 2 时，多类别布里尔得分的平均值为 0.825439。

sents.en: This diagnostic reflects both prediction quality and coverage of R0–R3; its discrepancies cannot be interpreted directly as parameter errors in these assignments or as a measure of the entire prior’s predictive accuracy, since joint prediction with other role instances is not implemented here.
sents.zh: 这一诊断既反映了预测质量，也反映了 R0–R3 的覆盖范围；其差异不能直接解释为这些分配中参数的错误，也不能视为整个先验预测准确性的衡量，因为此处并未实现与其他角色实例的联合预测。
